predecessor_evidence: reports/research/LEDGER.md E-001..E-004: four single-symbol mechanisms, all NO_EDGE, all with the same direction-drift signature

dataset.alignment_rule: all ten legs must share one bar grid; a misaligned panel is refused, never ranked

execution_model.entry: MARKET at the next bar open after a rank-state transition
execution_model.exit: static bracket, stop 2% / target 4% of entry, stop-first intrabar, 48-bar time exit
execution_model.funding: actual venue settlements inside the holding window
execution_model.sizing: risk 100 USDT per leg; R = net PnL / 100

candidates.statement: Relative strength across the ten perpetuals persists: the weakest trailing-24h symbols underperform the strongest by more than the round-trip cost and more than a random two-and-two selection at the same bars.
candidates.direction_rule: LONG the two weakest trailing-24h symbols, SHORT the two strongest
candidates.event_rule: trade only when a symbol newly enters an extreme rank; staying in the extreme is not a new observation
candidates.falsified_by: net expectancy <= 0, or not above the matched random selection, or concentration in fewer than 6 of 10 symbols

matched_random_selection.pool: at each treatment event bar, pick two random longs and two random shorts from the same ten symbols, priced with the identical bracket, costs, funding and time exit
matched_random_selection.p_value: one-sided Monte Carlo: (1 + draws at least as good) / (1 + draws)

unit_of_comparison: per-leg net R; cross-market clustering unit is the per-symbol mean net R

gates.multiple_testing: Holm over the hypotheses in this family (one primary)

decision_rule: DEV_CANDIDATE only when every gate passes; otherwise NO_EDGE, or INCONCLUSIVE below the trade minimum. DEV_CANDIDATE nominates a native validation and is not an economic edge claim. PASS can never be awarded by this screen.

cumulative_dev_budget.note: Development is exploratory and can only nominate. A frozen candidate on the sealed holdout is the first confirmatory test.

known_limitations: legs are priced independently and overlap in time; the pooled mean is an expectancy estimate, not a portfolio equity curve
shared-account competition and margin are not modelled by this screen; a finalist must pass the native shared-account runner
dev and holdout share one six-month regime
